mutants.why: resolveExactMatch must ACCEPT an exact hit whose confidence >= min_confidence; flipping < to > rejects the confidence-1.0 direct mapping (1.0 > 0.5) and returns nullopt. findMatch_exactMapping asserts QVERIFY(result.has_value())

a direct exact-mapping hit reports perfect confidence 1.0; degrading it to 0.5 still clears the min_confidence gate but violates the strength assertion. findMatch_exactMapping asserts QVERIFY(result->confidence > 0.9)
hasMapping reports true when the normalized key exists; negating makes a present mapping read as absent. hasMapping_existingKey asserts QVERIFY(matcher.hasMapping("ExistingApp")) after addMapping

removeMapping must delete the entry for the given (normalized) app name; removing the empty key leaves the real mapping in place. removeMapping_noLongerFound asserts QVERIFY(!matcher.hasMapping("ToRemove")) after removeMapping

getMapping must look up the normalized app name; keying on the empty string always returns the default "". addMapping_canRetrieve asserts QCOMPARE(matcher.getMapping("Test App"), QString("test-app-choco"))
getMappingCount must report the live mapping count; forcing 0 hides the built-in mappings. constructor_initializesCommonMappings asserts QVERIFY(matcher.getMappingCount() > 0)

the exported app_name must be the mapping key; writing the choco value instead means re-import stores under the wrong key. exportImport_roundTrip asserts QVERIFY(imported.hasMapping("UniqueTestApp")) after export+import

the DoS size guard must reject only oversized files; flipping > to < rejects every normal (small) mappings file so import returns false. exportImport_roundTrip asserts QVERIFY(imported.importMappings(exportPath))
the open-failure guard fails closed on a bad open; dropping the ! makes a SUCCESSFUL open return false and never write. exportImport_roundTrip asserts QVERIFY(original.exportMappings(exportPath))
importMappings must reject non-object JSON; dropping the ! makes a VALID object doc return false before applying mappings. exportImport_roundTrip asserts QVERIFY(imported.importMappings(exportPath))

fuzzyMatch_similarityAtThresholdMatches drives fuzzyMatch via the friend cache-seed seam (cacheSearch short-circuits fetchSearchOutput before searchPackage's init gate, so an uninitialized ChocolateyManager works). calculateSimilarity("abcd","axyd") == 0.6 EXACTLY (jaro-winkler 0.7 + levenshtein-sim 0.5, averaged), landing on kFuzzyMatchThreshold. Real >= returns the match; the > boundary-tighten rejects the exact-threshold candidate and returns nullopt, so QVERIFY(result.has_value()) fails

fuzzyMatch_bestSelectTieKeepsFirst drives fuzzyMatch via the friend cache-seed seam with two candidates ("abcde", "abcdz") that both contain the query "abcd" and so score an EXACT tie at kContainedNameSimilarity (0.85). <= keeps the FIRST candidate on the tie; the < mutant lets the later equal-scoring package overwrite it. QCOMPARE(result->choco_package, "abcde") passes for real and fails for the mutant (which selects "abcdz")
